paragraphs: Spider Strategies sells Spider Impact, a strategy management product that its homepage says can gather data in one place, update it automatically, and provide insights toward shared goals. The homepage describes connecting top-level strategy to departmental priorities and team-level performance so that work at each tier is visible. Listed capabilities include visibility into key performance indicators and strategic initiatives, with tracking of progress and trends. The site also describes visualization tools that turn strategic data into charts, graphs, and interactive maps.

The homepage places the product across industry, government, and nonprofit. The about page states a mission to help businesses, governments, and nonprofits improve their performance. A customer story on the homepage credits Spider Impact with providing a transparent Common Operating Picture for the U.S. Army.

Spider Strategies began as a software consulting company and entered the Corporate Performance Management market in April 2004 with a product called Scoreboard. In September 2020, the company released Spider Impact, bringing QuickScore and Scoreboard together into one performance management solution. The company describes a worldwide network of partners, some of whom resell the software.
